scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The broad imported 1492 to 1500 polygon is not verified as an exclusive southern Aónikenk territory. The card distinguishes southern identity from the more expansive use of Tehuelche. No other people’s record is merged.
No founding year, first encounter or precise date of universal horse adoption is invented. The eighteenth-century weaving phase concerns documented practices among some groups.

The museum booklet was consulted as indexed page text. Its simplified account is used for specified material practices and trade, not for an unchanging division of labor or universal environmental harmony.
Méndez’s explanation of textile adoption is presented as interpretation. Actual early records are distinguished from proposed pathways of learning; no universal transition or shortage is asserted.
The four archaeological sites are twentieth-century contexts surveyed in 2015. Mixed Tehuelche/Aónikenk-Mapuche family histories are preserved; the glass tools are not projected into 1492.

The education booklet was read through the official Educ.ar PDF mirror after the national-library URL failed. Conflicting 2011 and 2012 dates for Kopolke title recognition in that booklet are not repeated. No present legal status is inferred from its 2016 account.

Current community self-description supersedes outdated racial-purity extinction claims found in some museum summaries. No such claim is included. The account of state expansion concerns loss of land and autonomy, not a people’s disappearance.
The language source is the project authors’ August 2018 description, not a claim to have played the recordings. It distinguishes elicited or reconstructed texts from spontaneous speech.
The foundation’s activity page labels its school accounts 2025 and supplies an explicit February launch date. No current speaker count, learning outcome or present officeholder is asserted.
Independent historical review, geometry assessment and depth certification remain pending.
